name: E.V.R. Maniammaiyar Marriage Assistance
full_name: E.V.R. Maniammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme for Daughters of Poor Widows
summary: Money towards a daughter's marriage for widowed mothers on a low income.
benefit_note: ₹25,000 with an 8 gram 22 carat gold coin. ₹50,000 if the daughter is a graduate.
how_to_apply: Collect your husband's death certificate, an income certificate and proof of the marriage.
Apply through the Social Welfare Office for your district.
The money is paid by ECS along with the gold coin.

curation_notes: DRAFT — not yet read by a human against the official page. Do not ship.

Taken from the Tamil Nadu Social Welfare Department marriage assistance page on 2026-08-09. That page describes six different marriage assistance schemes; this file is only the one for daughters of poor widows. The other five are separate schemes and each needs its own file.

TO CONFIRM: the minimum age of the bride. The official page does not state one, and no rule has been written for it rather than guess. It almost certainly exists — 18 is the legal minimum age of marriage — so find it and add the rule.
TO CONFIRM: the documents list. The official page lists none. All five here are inferred from the stated conditions and none is quoted.

NOT MODELLED: the ₹50,000 rate for a daughter who is a graduate. The format has one benefit_value per scheme and cannot express a benefit that varies by the answer. benefit_note carries it as text. If more schemes do this, the format needs a benefit tiers concept.

NOT MODELLED: that a marriage is actually taking place. Nothing in the profile captures an upcoming wedding, so this scheme will match every widowed mother on a low income with a daughter. That is a false positive and needs either a profile field or a note on the card before it ships.
The scheme reaches the daughter through the mother's profile, which is the same parent-applies pattern as the child schemes.
